CustomField.description: Estimated minutes to complete this page, shown as a chip such as '4 min' on its stage card in Stages Mode. The overview adds them up for the total time remaining. Whole minutes, up to 999. Leave blank to show no chip. No effect in page-by-page forms.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter a whole number of minutes (e.g. 4) to show a time-estimate chip on this page's card in the Stages view. The overview also adds these up to show total time remaining; leave it blank to hide the chip for this stage.
CustomField.label: Estimated Time (Minutes)
